verdict.rationale: Shipping an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a robotics framework like ROS 2, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only conventional RST documentation and contains no llms.txt or docs written for agents. A community remark that LLMs handle ROS boilerplate well is a user-side observation, not a documented product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
